name: 42191-toppdecode-gemma3-270m-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: Gemma3ForCausalLM dense decoder: 18 layers, hidden 640, intermediate 2048, 4 query heads over 1 KV head with head_dim 256, sliding-window attention on 15 of the 18 layers (window 512, pattern 6), tied embeddings, vocabulary 262144, bf16, one safetensors shard of ~0.54 GiB.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=512, warmup 20%, bounded at 4096 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, `request_format: plain`, streaming, fixed length by construction: every request is exactly 128 prompt tokens and exactly 512 output tokens (min=max on both), with `ignore_eos` set.
purpose: A compact streaming chat assistant generating 512-token replies from short prompts for 512 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
model: unsloth/gemma-3-270m-it
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-model-len: 1024
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enforce-eager: false
